mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5%, it signals a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) relative to the prior month indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime where industrial production (INDPRO) is declining (INDPRO < 95.0), manufacturing output slowdowns reduce corporate profitability and increase recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.1%, it signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.1%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates improving consumer confidence and residential investment, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery regime characterized by year-over-year payroll growth exceeding 0.5% (PAYEMS), corporate hiring activity supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% YoY, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability and increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
